eligibility.value: Persons who already have PAN but want a new PAN card, or want to make changes/corrections in existing PAN details.
eligibility.quote: You can submit the application in the form "Request for New PAN Card or/and Changes or Correction in PAN data" in the following cases: 1. When you already have PAN but want a new PAN card, 2. When you want to make some changes or corrections in your existing PAN details.

eligibility.value: Applicants who already have a PAN allotted but require a PAN card with no data changes.
eligibility.quote: This application should be used when PAN has already been allotted to the applicant but applicant requires a PAN card.

eligibility.value: Applicants who have already been allotted a PAN but want to make change or correction in PAN data.
eligibility.quote: This application should be used when PAN has already been allotted to the applicant but applicant wants to make change/correction in PAN data.

eligibility.value: Any person or entity requiring a new PAN card, reprint, or changes/correction in PAN data.
eligibility.quote: Request For Changes Or Correction in PAN Data Or/ And reprint of New PAN Card

fees.value: Fee for physical PAN card dispatch in India is Rs 107 (inclusive of taxes) at TIN-FCs/Physical mode, or Rs 101 via paperless mode. Dispatch outside India is Rs 1,017 or Rs 1,011 respectively. Without physical PAN card (e-PAN only) fee is Rs 72 or Rs 66.
fees.quote: Dispatch of physical PAN Card in India (Communication address is Indian address) | 91 | 107

fees.value: 107 Rupees if physical PAN Card is required within India.
fees.quote: If physical PAN Card is required, ` 107/- (including goods & service tax) will have to be paid by the applicant.

fees.value: 910 Rupees additional dispatch charge if PAN card is to be dispatched outside India.
fees.quote: In case, the PAN card is to be dispatched outside India then additional dispatch charge of ` 910/- will have to be paid by applicant.

fees.value: 72 Rupees if physical PAN Card is not required.
fees.quote: If physical PAN Card is not required ` 72/- (including goods & service tax) will have to be paid by the applicant.

issuing_authority.quote: This facility is only available for those PAN holders whose latest PAN application was processed through Protean e-Gov and / or e-Filing portal of Income Tax Department.

steps.value: Fill all the columns of the form and tick the box(es) on the left margin of the appropriate item where change/correction is to be done.
steps.quote: The applicant is required to fill all the columns of the form and tick the box(es) on the left margin of the appropriate item where change/correction is to be done.

steps.value: Obtain the application form from IT PAN Service Centres, TIN-Facilitation Centres, or download it from the specified websites.
steps.quote: Applicants may obtain the ‘Request for New PAN Card or/and Changes or Correction in PAN Data’ Form in the format prescribed by Income Tax Department from any IT PAN Service Centres (managed by UTIITSL) or TIN-Facilitation Centres (TIN-FCs)/PAN Centres (managed by Protean), or any other stationery vendor providing such forms or download from the Income Tax Department ia.gov.in) / UTIITSL website (www.utiitsl.com) / Protean website (www.protean-tinpan.com).

steps.value: Fill the form legibly in BLOCK LETTERS and preferably in BLACK INK in English.
steps.quote: Form to be filled legibly in BLOCK LETTERS and preferably in BLACK INK. Form should be filled in English only

steps.value: Attach required supporting documents for identity, address, date of birth, or changes.
steps.quote: It is mandatory to attach proof of identity, proof of address and proof of date of birth with PAN application.

steps.value: Submit the application form along with the prescribed fee and receive an acknowledgment containing a unique number.
steps.quote: Applicant will receive an acknowledgment containing a unique number on acceptance of this form.
